verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe the exact scenario — 'a designer shares a mockup, and the system implements it without handoffs' — plus a 'Design mode' where a user selects a UI element and describes a change, which Droid then acts on, and shows diffs before applying changes. This directly matches the PM/no-handoff story as a first-party documented capability. missing for 10: independent or hands-on evidence (case study, review) confirming a non-engineer PM can actually drive this workflow end-to-end without engineering involvement.
